comments.author: @nizarjiwan6970
comments.text: Great documentary. Beautiful story of what connects Kazakhstan’ history and heritage to Soviet Empire’s ambitions in Central Heritage that the west is totally ignorant about. Only bias in this documentary is the fact that you left out of it the mention of the role of the influence of Islamic civilization!!!  No sunrise there  - given you wear a limited Western lens. Still, a very enlightening and an educational contribution. Thank you. Nizar Jiwan, Toronto.

replies.author: @WhereonEarth4K
replies.text: Thank you for the thoughtful read, and fair point on the gap - Islamic civilization's influence on Central Asian history, including Kazakhstan's, deserves real coverage that this one didn't fully deliver. Appreciate you flagging it specifically rather than just in passing.
